query:
SELECT
            width_bucket(latency_ms::float8, $1::float8[]) AS "bucket!",
            COUNT(*)::bigint AS "count!"
          FROM ai_requests
          WHERE created_at >= $2 AND created_at < $3
            AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL
             AND ($4::TEXT[] IS NULL OR ai_requests.user_id = ANY($4))
          GROUP BY 1
          ORDER BY 1
